thread:
Renee: Customer SkylarkAI (customer_id: skylark-77) disputed INV-20260620. They were billed $9,300 in burst charges despite having a strict burst cap configured. Invoice: https://invoices.redwood/INV-20260620.pdf. Can billing investigate?

Diego: Pulling usage export now: s3://billing-exports/skylark-77/2026-06.csv. BILL-3342 created to track.

infra-bot: Export ready skylark-77/2026-06.csv. Summary: total tokens 1.1B, burst tokens 95M, burst charges $9,300.

Sonal: Customer claims they set burst_cap_tokens=5M and expected throttling. Look for any config mismatch or policy override.

Diego: Querying policy_evals and router logs for 2026-06-19 22:00-23:30 UTC.

Diego: Found that their commit quota was honored but an emergency fallback rule kicked in when a control-plane heartbeat to the reserved pool failed for ~7 minutes. Router applied policy fallback=allow_on_demand to avoid 5xxs. That bypassed the burst cap enforcement because the throttle logic ran in the reserved pool agent not in the router.

Renee: So we routed traffic to on-demand without applying the customer's burst cap. That's on us.

Sonal: Action items: 1) Recompute billed usage attributing affected tokens at reserved-rate and mark on-demand differential as creditable. 2) Open INF ticket to change router so fallback still honors burst caps (INF-7922). 3) Offer SLA goodwill credit for customer friction.

Diego: Corrected export posted s3://billing-exports/skylark-77/corrections/2026-06-reserved-attrib.csv. Affected tokens = 61M. Differential (on-demand minus reserved) = $7,420.

Renee: Recommend provisional credit equal to differential $7,420 plus $500 goodwill = $7,920 applied to INV-20260620 while INF-7922 runs. Approvers: @Renee (Finance), @Diego (Billing).

Diego: I approve. Applying provisional credit $7,920 and annotating invoice: "Provisional routing differential credit - under review."

infra-bot: BILL-3342 updated: provisional credit $7,920 applied. INF-7922 opened: ensure fallback preserves quota enforcement. PM-1052 filed for permanent fix and post-mortem.

Sonal: Sent customer message: "We've applied a provisional credit of $7,920 while we correct our routing and billing records. Final reconciliation expected within 72 hours." Skylark replied: "Thanks  appreciate the quick handling"

Diego: After INF-7922 validation and final reconciliation, final differential confirmed = $7,420. Since provisional credit was $7,920, net credit stands at $7,920 (we keep goodwill). Approving final close and billing adjustment.

Renee: Approved. Apply final credit and close BILL-3342. Also ensure PM-1052 includes a test to simulate control-plane heartbeat loss.

infra-bot: BILL-3342 closed. Final credit applied: $7,920 to INV-20260620. Notification sent to skylark-77.

Sonal: Customer confirmed invoice reconciliation and resumed payment. Closing thread."
